posts.name: Cult of Gloom
posts.cooked:
The ture idenity of the Bloodsworn entity can only be…

We are glad to hear that Kaargra understands the importance of showmanship. Its amazing what you can get the masses to cheer for with catch tunes, bright lights, and snazzy costumes.

 

Breaking character, I was thrilled that my letter's reference to Greazer was caught upon. And I loved Fashion. There is sadly often a lack of superheroes that engage in tradionally feminine hobbies like fashion, and an inventor who makes cool gadget outfits to fight crime is awesome.

Sadly being hated by fans in the 80s or 90s and written off is a very realistic response from the comic community…heck, it would likely even still happen today in some circles. Still, very cool character. I fully intent to steal the concept for my RPG, though I might ditch the backstory and let her start fresh.

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
Cult of Gloom:

Sadly being hated by fans in the 80s or 90s and written off is a very realistic response from the comic community…heck, it would likely even still happen today in some circles.

It would, since as I alluded, Patsy Walker was a similar supermodel romantic comic turned superhero character, and she is a bit divisive. (More or less hardcore fans often dislike her and lady fans and lighthearted fans often like her.)

Shame because I agree, gadget outfits are wicked awesome. I know if I was a mad inventor I'd totally want to be one with style. It also reminds me of Hedy Lamarr, who was a talented inventor in addition to being a beautiful actress.

Also, I feel like your Cult should get in touch with Argent; dude clearly has a flair for causing fear and nightmares in extreme circumstances.
